name: Chikatetsu-Akatsuka
tagline: Shinjuku in 29 minutes and Shibuya in 34 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Itabashi City, where Tobu and Tokyo Metro run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 39 minutes to Otemachi, 29 minutes to Shinjuku, 34 minutes to Shibuya and 56 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 34.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 34.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 31.7 m to 35.7 m, a difference of 4.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 23 clinics and 18 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 練馬光が丘病院, about 22 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 成増厚生病院, about 35 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. Tobu Tojo Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line also call here. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (Tobu runs 1 line and Tokyo Metro runs 2 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line runs at 153% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 東池袋→護国寺, which this station is not on. Tobu Tojo Line runs at 131%. Its busiest stretch is 北池袋→池袋, which this station is likewise not on. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line runs at 117%. Its busiest stretch is 要町→池袋, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Narimasu is ahead on quiet, but Chikatetsu-Akatsuka is ahead on the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Chikatetsu-Akatsuka in a straight line. It takes 3 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Chikatetsu-Akatsuka.

neighbours.lead: Tobu-Nerima is ahead on quiet, but Chikatetsu-Akatsuka is ahead on the number of lines and how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Chikatetsu-Akatsuka in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Chikatetsu-Akatsuka.

noiseSources: 川越街道 (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
北町豊玉線 (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 15 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Neither the station nor the ground around it falls inside the projected flood area.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
